senses.gloss: SV0283 तृण धान्य tṛṇa dhānya Millets- Grains from graminae family which grow stray and wild. They includes Indian millet, little millet, Kodo millet etc.
DG0362 तृण पञ्चमुल tṛṇa pañcamula A group of five grasses viz. Desmostachya bipinnata, Arundo donax, Saccharum spontaneum, Saccharum officinarum, Imperata cylindrica; having properties like diuretic.
AF2286 तृणच्छेद tṛṇaccheda Cutting grass by nail
